title: Chat Opacity
description: This is a simple mod that allows the user to toggle chat visibility with a keybind, and nothing more.
body:
Chat Opacity is a simple mod that allows the user to toggle chat visibility with a single keybind.

After installing the mod and dropping it into your mods folder, navigate to your keybinds and scroll down until you see "Chat Opacity Mod", and there you can change your keybind if necessary.

This mod does NOT erase the chat history, all it does is simply sets the chat text opacity to 0%.
